title: Scalar action becomes invertible on a basic open
statement: Let A be any commutative ring, a ∈ A, and K any integer-indexed cochain complex of A-modules. Apply the tilde functor on Spec A [def-pc-scheme] degreewise and restrict the resulting complex of structure-sheaf modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] to D(a). The image of the scalar chain endomorphism a times id_K is an isomorphism of complexes. No Koszul, boundedness, regularity, or finiteness condition is assumed.

source.place: Tag 01HR, Section 26.5, especially Lemmas 26.5.1 and 26.5.4; basic-open vanishing used in Tag 09IR; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01HR and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09IR

proof.text: The structure sheaf on D(a) contains the inverse of a, compatibly on every smaller open. This is the localization description in Tag 01HR. Mathlib Scheme.Modules.isUnit_algebraMap_end_of_le_basicOpen already proves that scalar multiplication is a unit endomorphism on sections over every open contained in D(a).

The image under tilde of a times an A-module identity acts on sections by multiplication by a: use the localization formula for tilde.map, or prove the equality on each localized fraction. Multiplication by the inverse section is therefore its inverse on the restricted module sheaf, and commutes with every restriction map.

Do this in every degree of K. The inverse maps commute with the differentials by linearity over the structure sheaf, giving an inverse chain map; equivalently use Mathlib HomologicalComplex.Hom.isIso_of_components after proving that every component is an isomorphism. If a=0, D(a) is empty and all the relevant sheaves are zero. The argument also permits the zero ring and the zero complex.

theorem basicOpen_tilde_scalar_isIso
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (a : A) (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) :
    IsIso
      (((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
        (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)
        (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
        ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} A)
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
          _ _ _ _ (tilde.functor (.of A))
          ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
          (a • 𝟙 K)))
